description: A tiny store for the extension's tests.

plugins.name: demo-skills
plugins.description: Three small skills for reading and releasing code.
plugins.author: Alran test fixtures
exampleQueries: Give me a tour of this repository

skills.name: changelog-check
skills.description: Use when checking that a change has a changelog entry and that the entry says what a user would notice.

skills.name: code-tour
skills.description: Use when a newcomer needs a walk through an unfamiliar repository, covering entry points, data flow and where to read first.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Use when drafting release notes from the commits since the last tag, grouped by the changes a user would notice.

plugins.name: hook-demo
plugins.description: One Skill and a session-start hook, used to test the approval step before a Plugin that runs commands is installed.
plugins.author: Alran test fixtures

skills.description: Use when asked to say hello from the demo plugin, to check that the plugin and its hook are loaded.
